name: physics-paper-principles
title_zh: 物理论文里每句话该长什么样，它有一套判据
tagline_zh: 写 LaTeX 时最耗人的不是公式，是那句「显然」到底显不显然。它把句子清晰度、叙事弧、物理先行的定义。
tagline_en: The slow part of LaTeX isn't the math, it's deciding whether 'clearly' is earned. This gives you checkable rules.
desc_en: Graduate-level physics and mathematics prose principles: sentence clarity, narrative arc, physically led definitions, and math-logic types. Use when writing or reviewing physics-paper LaTeX. Pair with physics-paper-editing for the coworker-loop workflow and physics-paper-editing-section for whole sections. Not a process skill — no marks, Tasks, or merge.
why_zh: 它不替你改，只给判据：定义必须先有物理图像再上符号，逻辑类型要分清蕴含与等价。语感说不清的地方。
why_en: It doesn't rewrite for you; it gives criteria. Definitions earn their symbols from physics first, and implication is kept.
limit_zh: 只是原则清单，不产出批注、Tasks 或合并结果；要跑 coworker 循环得配 physics-paper-edi…
limit_en: Principles only: no marks, Tasks, or merges. Pair with physics-paper-editing for the coworker loop and -section for whole sections. Graduate physics.
title_en: Sentence-level rules for physics paper prose
